systemic_exposure.summary: Higher scores mean the compound is more likely to be absorbed and reach systemic circulation.

persistence_distribution.summary: Higher scores mean longer residence time and broader tissue distribution.

broad_toxicity.summary: Higher scores mean stronger broad toxicity concern even without a clean single-event mapping.

metabolic_interaction.summary: Higher scores mean more CYP-mediated interaction or metabolism dependence.

druglikeness_caution.summary: Higher scores mean the chemistry looks less clean or less drug-like, so treat downstream mapping with more caution.
